description:
Found 2026-08-12. The simulator says it lacks correlations the library next door already implements.

THE SITUATION:

  crates/outram-park-digital-twin-engine/src/htr10/  (arrived via the pull)
    kta.rs        kta_friction_factor, kta_pressure_gradient,
                  packed_bed_reynolds, superficial_mass_flux
                  -> REAL KTA packed-bed friction, tested against published Re
    zbs.rs        zbs_effective_conductivity + an 18-point table
                  -> REAL Zehner-Bauer-Schlunder effective bed conductivity
    design.rs     Htr10DesignPoint, Htr10FuelTemperatureLimits
    neutronics.rs

  crates/outram-park-digital-twin-engine/examples/htgr_sim_v1/physics/
    module docs state, in these words: 'no packed-bed friction correlation, no
    effective bed conductivity'. Uses instead a quadratic loss anchored to the
    published circulator head, and an INVENTED overall pebble-to-helium HTC of
    160 W/m2K. Re-derives HTR-10 design constants that design.rs already holds.

NOTHING IN THE WORKSPACE USES src/htr10/ — a grep for 'htr10::' finds only doc
mentions in src/htgr_opcua/. It is declared in lib.rs and otherwise inert.

CAUSE, recorded so it is not repeated: when briefing the pebble-bed work I only
inspected examples/htgr_sim_v1/ and never checked src/. I then explicitly told
the agent to DROP KTA and ZBS as over-scoped. Both already existed. The agent
followed the brief correctly; the brief was wrong.

WHAT TO DO:

  1. Wire physics/primary_loop.rs to htr10::kta for the bed pressure drop,
     replacing the anchored quadratic. The KTA path can be verified against the
     gold pressure drop recorded in docs/reactor-scoping/vtb-findings.md
     section 5 — a real gate, not a plausibility check.
  2. Wire the bed thermal resistance to htr10::zbs instead of the invented HTC,
     or state clearly why a lumped HTC is still preferred at this fidelity.
  3. Replace duplicated design constants with htr10::design::Htr10DesignPoint
     so there is ONE source of truth for the operating point. Two copies WILL
     drift.
  4. Update the 'what is real / what is illustrative' contracts afterwards —
     they will then be understating what the model does, which is the opposite
     error but still wrong.

CAUTION: keep the honest contracts accurate at every step. Wiring KTA makes the
friction real; it does NOT make the single-lumped-node bed a resolved model, and
the nodalisation prose must stay.

Depends on op-szmi (the epic). Related: op-szmi.6 (sourced piping).
title: htgr_sim_v1 duplicates src/htr10/ instead of using it — KTA and ZBS already exist, unwired
